# reverse_standardize { #wass2s.reverse_standardize }

```python
reverse_standardize(ds_st, ds, clim_year_start=None, clim_year_end=None)
```

Reverse standardization of a dataset to original units.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                               | Description                                                              | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ds_st           | xarray.Dataset or xarray.DataArray | Standardized dataset or data array (z-scores).                           | _required_ |
| ds              | xarray.Dataset or xarray.DataArray | Original dataset used to compute standardization parameters.             | _required_ |
| clim_year_start | int                                | Start year of the climatology period. If None, uses the full time range. | `None`     |
| clim_year_end   | int                                | End year of the climatology period. If None, uses the full time range.   | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                               | Description                              |
|--------|------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.Dataset or xarray.DataArray | Dataset or data array in original units. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Reverses standardization using ds_st * std + mean, where mean and std are
computed from the original dataset over the specified period.
